requirement.title: SpringGear JDK21 compatibility migration
requirement.summary: Upgrade the existing active reactor to JDK21 with preserved core behavior and executable regression evidence.

sources.content: User changed the SpringGear migration target to JDK21 and authorized bounded environment-compatible regression; do not pursue JDK26.

goals.problem: The framework reactor still targets Java8 and uses older build/processor dependencies.
goals.outcome: Maintain and test the framework using JDK21 without redesigning its public API.
goals.success_condition: Current-result JDK21 compilation, bytecode and behavior tests pass, with exact source and complete SDLC evidence.

in_scope: Behavior tests, migration instructions and local Sandbox lifecycle
out_of_scope: Production deployment or Maven Central release

requirements.statement: Compile the existing active four-module reactor on JDK21 and emit Java21 class files.
Preserve existing workflow context, handler ordering, unsupported-handler behavior and exception conversion without changing public SpringGear source.
Align the minimal compiler, processor, Spring and logging dependencies while retaining the Spring5 API generation; do not migrate to a new architecture.
Execute all declared regression tests with a real JUnit engine; zero failures, errors or skipped tests; a repeatable Maven verify succeeds.
Document actual scope and local build commands; preserve upstream source/license and do not publish or modify upstream branches.

acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Runtime feature 21 and compiled class major 65 are asserted.
Context arguments, shared values, handler order/skip/failure and Spring configuration behavior pass.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Compile Lombok-generated members and load Spring context
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Constructors/accessors and Spring configuration enhancement work without add-opens or public-source rewriting.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Execute the current test class on the current final result
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Ten distinct tests execute, zero failures/errors/skips; Maven verify packages the active reactor.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Inspect changed paths and migration instructions
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Only POM compatibility, regression tests and migration instructions change; no deployment goals or upstream effects.

lifecycle_applicability.basis: Compatibility design, ordered build/test implementation, current-result verification and local Sandbox delivery.
